title: Accessibility rule catalog
description: docs/adr/0012 point 1/2: a rule catalog (CONTEXT.md - fixed for a rule-set version, extracted-once, not derived from any crawl) mechanically extracted from axe-core 4.10.2's own rule metadata (axe.getRules() + each rule's default impact) - axe's own slug rule ids, not invented pragma ids. accessibility_requirements carries axe's wcag2a/wcag111-style tags, the same field ACT Rules Format 1.1 SS4.4 defines for citing external requirements a rule's failure violates, kept as a flat tag list rather than the full ACT accessibility-requirements object (structural correctness for pragma's own fields, not the full official ACT schema). act_id cites the published ACT rule id only where Deque's own mapping table confirms a correspondence.

impact.description: axe-core's own native severity for this rule, carried verbatim alongside the SARIF-normalized level (docs/adr/0012 point 3).
